verdicts.reason: Both are unusable. A has a readable headline at left, but the food photos are tiny thumbnails, a blank white frame sits empty, the pattern tile is a mess, and the brand name and URL are scattered along the bottom. B puts the photos in a tiny strip at the bottom-left, leaves the middle and right mostly empty, and shows a stray pattern block. Its headline is small and floating, and the brand, URL and 'RESTAURANT' are crammed together. A keeps clearer reading order and a stronger headline, so it is slightly less bad.
